description_policy: Written for RETRIEVAL, not marketing. Each says what the tool does in the nouns and verbs a caller would use mid-task, names the concrete things it returns, and avoids the tool's own brand vocabulary. Description quality is the ceiling on every number Phase 0 produces, so each was written after calling the API and reading its real response.
selection_policy: Chosen as what a general agent toolkit would plausibly wrap: well-known, free, no-auth public APIs across unrelated domains. Deliberately NOT chosen by reading eval/queries.json — selecting tools to match the frozen queries would contaminate the measurement from the other direction. Whether a given query turns out answerable is therefore an outcome.
excluded: dictionaryapi.dev — connection failure, no response at all
restcountries.com — returns HTTP 200 with a deprecation error body on v3.1 and v5 alike

tools.name: Weather Forecast
tools.description: Weather forecast by hour and by day for a latitude and longitude: temperature, rainfall probability, wind speed and cloud cover, up to sixteen days ahead.

tools.name: Address to Coordinates
tools.description: Converts a street address, place name or landmark into latitude and longitude coordinates.

input.query: string, an address or place name

tools.name: Coordinates to Address
tools.description: Converts latitude and longitude coordinates into a street address with neighbourhood, city, region, postcode and country.

tools.name: Currency Converter
tools.description: Exchange rates between national currencies such as GHS, USD, EUR, GBP and JPY. Converts an amount of money from one country's currency into another's, at today's rate or at a past date's rate.

tools.name: Encyclopedia Summary
tools.description: Encyclopedia article summary for a notable person, place, organisation, historical event or concept. Returns factual background prose with the article title and link.

tools.name: Public Holidays

tools.name: Sunrise and Sunset Times
tools.description: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon, civil dawn, civil dusk and length of daylight for a latitude and longitude on a date.

tools.name: Ground Elevation
tools.description: Height of the ground in metres above sea level at a latitude and longitude.

tools.name: Postal Code Lookup

tools.name: Country Development Indicator

rewrite_note: v3: short, concrete, POSITIVE-ONLY descriptions. v2 added boundary clauses of the form 'not X' and recall got WORSE: recall@1 fell 90.9 to 81.8 and the no-answer maximum rose 0.2721 to 0.3632. Embeddings carry no representation of negation, so 'does not look up the owner or country of another address' injected exactly that vocabulary and pulled public-ip-lookup TOWARD such queries, by +0.1331. Qualifier clauses also diluted the core signal: wikipedia-summary on a history query collapsed from 0.2994 to 0.0890. v3 therefore differentiates by being specific about what a tool DOES and never names the neighbouring capability it is being distinguished from.
